description.default: Free tier forever (up to 10 documents, 1 vault): real-time encrypt selected documents + all assets (images/videos/PDF/xlsx, any format) into a self-developed single-file vault (.sydb); zero plaintext (in-memory injection); unlimited size; Argon2id KDF (OWASP-first) for new vaults. Free tier includes lock/hide with body mask, recovery key (forgot-password recovery), auto/incremental backup, dedup, in-vault recycle bin, restore-on-remove, orphan recovery, password hints, weak-password detection, sensitive-info alert, revision history rollback, audit log, device-bound activation code. Paid unlocks: unlimited documents & vaults, WebDAV two-way sync, mobile read/write (PIN session), TOTP two-factor unlock, tamper/ransomware monitor, burn-after-reading one-time share, OCR full-text image search (tesseract, CDN model), TF-IDF semantic auto-sharding, folder zip import, central vault directory, auto update check. 14-day full trial. Paid license (WeChat nglzhy).
description.zh_CN: 🆓 免费版永久可用（最多 10 篇文档、1 个密库）：把选中的文档及全部附件（图片/视频/PDF/xlsx 任意格式）实时加密进一个自研单文件数据库（.sydb），工作区零明文（内存注入显示），容量无上限，新建库默认 Argon2id 加密（OWASP 首选 KDF）。免费版含：锁定隐藏与正文遮罩、恢复密钥（忘记密码可找回）、自动/增量备份、资产去重、库内回收站、移出自动还原、孤儿找回、密码提示、弱密码检测、敏感信息提醒、版本历史回滚、审计日志、设备绑定激活码（防一码多用）。⭐ 付费版解锁：无限文档与无限密库、WebDAV 双向同步、移动端读写（6 位访问码会话）、TOTP 双因素解锁、防勒索/防篡改监控、阅后即焚一次性分享、OCR 图片全文搜索（tesseract，模型走 CDN 不占插件体积）、TF-IDF 语义智能分库、文件夹整包入库、集中分库目录、自动更新检查。14 天全功能体验；付费授权（微信 nglzhy）。
